name: Dura Flintscar
source_profile:
Dura Flintscar (NE) is a wealthy merchant factor who coordinates much of the Exchange's

surface commerce. She maintains an extensive network of brokers and intermediaries, rarely dealing directly with outsiders. Dura has cultivated relationships with certain Cinderhook goblin merchants and knows that legitimate Cadorian businesses are increasingly dependent upon duergar-produced materials.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 79 (source excerpt; may be partial)
